coordinator_sheet_notes: A tin-toy lab robot with a big lens eye, a warning light, slinky pincer arms, a self-destruct button and a yanked-out power cord; tank treads. Hero City is spooky level 1 (DESIGN-027), so the lens eye may glow red in dim light. Attack: the warning light spins, then a pincer lunge. Defeat: sparks, the dome pops and it slumps smoking, held.
sheet_vs_model_note: The sheet and its notes were written as a kid-safe robot with no sparks, smoke or scary eye. The coordinator's approval notes, written under Tom's September 26 DESIGN-027 ruling, set Hero City at spooky level 1 and ask for a red-glowing lens eye, a spinning warning light before a pincer lunge, and a sparking, dome-popping, smoking defeat. Those notes supersede the sheet notes' kid-safe limits only; the silhouette, colours, proportions, parody hooks and sheet pose carry over to the model.
ruling: Tom, September 26: Claude Opus 5.5 does the remaining WO111 Blender work; assets without an Astra concept follow a painted Blender reference sheet that the coordinator reviewed (PRD-004 Q-07). Tom, September 26 (DESIGN-027): genuinely scary is welcome where the era fits, with no gore.
